name: Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona
summary: Public university on its own campus at Bellaterra, outside Barcelona; six bachelor's taught mostly or fully in English, from AI to economics.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10), then Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Artificial intelligence across its fields: machine learning, natural language, computer vision, data analysis, robotics and multi-agent systems, with attention to ethics.
programmes.ib: Taught in English; UAB expects a solid maths base and English at about B2.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration - English
programmes.about: Business administration taught in English with a professional focus: management, organisation and business English.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Economics - English
programmes.about: Four years of economics studied entirely in English, modelled on the Economics degrees of leading international universities.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Contemporary History, Politics and Economics
programmes.about: Contemporary history, politics and economics in one degree, preparing for public administration, international organisations and research.
programmes.ib: About 80% of subjects in English, 15% in Spanish and 5% in Catalan.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the cut-off shown is UAB's admission mark for 2026/27.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in English Studies
programmes.about: The linguistic, literary and cultural dimensions of English, leading to teaching, translation, publishing and communication careers.
programmes.ib: 90% in English; first-year cross-curricular subjects include some Catalan (5%) and Spanish (5%).
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the 2026/27 admission mark was 5.000, the lowest possible access grade.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Tourism - English
programmes.about: Tourism taught 100% in English at an affiliated school on the Bellaterra campus, with specialisations and practice in an on-campus hotel.
programmes.ib: B2 English recommended; no English test is required.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked in the Catalan pre-enrolment; the 2026/27 admission mark was 5.000, the lowest possible access grade.

notes: UAB asks for no test of the language you will be taught in.
Tourism is run by an affiliated school and costs €94 a credit, far above the public price of €17.69.
The four "English and ..." combined degrees are only about half in English, so they are not listed here.
